senses.gloss:
कृच्छ्र a. [cf. Uṇ. 2. 21]
—1 Causing trouble, painful; तथात्यजन्निमं देहं कृच्छ्राद् ग्राहाद्विमुत्त्यते Ms. 6. 78.
—2 Bad, miserable, evil.
—3 Wicked, sinful.
—4 Being in a difficult or painful situation.

कृच्छ्र + .{@-च्छ्रः, -च्छ्रम्@}
—1 A difficulty, trouble, hardship, misery, calamity, danger; कृच्छ्रं
 महत्तीर्णः R. 14. 6, 13. 77.
—2 Bodily mortification, penance, expiation; Ms. 4. 222, 5. 21, 11. 106.
—3 Torment, torture.
—4 A particular kind of religious penance (प्राजापत्य); कृच्छ्राणि
 चीर्त्वा च ततो यथोक्तानि द्विजोत्तमैः Mb. 13. 10. 64.

 चीर्त्वा च ततो यथोक्तानि द्विजोत्तमैः Mb. 13. 10. 64.

 miserably; लब्धं कृच्छ्रेण रक्ष्यते H. 1. 163.

कृच्छ्र + -अर्धः a penance lasting for six days only.

कृच्छ्र + -कृत् a. Undergoing a penance; कृच्छ्रकृद्धर्मकामस्तु महतीं
 श्रियमाप्नुयात् Y. 3. 327.

कृच्छ्र + -प्राण a.
—1 one whose life is in danger.
—2 breathing with difficulty.
—3 hardly supporting life.

कृच्छ्र + -साध्य a.
—1 curable with difficulty (as a patient or disease).
—2 accomplished with difficulty.

कृच्छ्रायते Den. Ā.
—1 To suffer, pain.
—2 To have wicked designs (in mind).
